# Authored numeric JITAN vectors

`jitan_reference.json` contains lengths and FNV-1a hashes of PCM16 samples from
784 deterministic inputs. There is no game audio or copied implementation here.
The input formulas are in `../voice_compression.rs`; the matrix is four sample
rates, two durations, mono/stereo, seven patterns and seven percentages.

The expected values were generated by executing the complete, unmodified
`crates/siglus_scene_vm/src/audio/jitan.rs` at siglus_rs commit
`5f358ef1360b0439e92aed2b749e8f25d8721954`, retrieved from its Git object.
A temporary Rust harness serialized each authored input as PCM16 WAVE, called
the reference's `convert_koe_wav`, extracted its data samples, and compared every
sample with CrySirror's independently implemented profile. All 784 comparisons
passed; hashes were then retained as the permanent regression fixture.

An initial comparison found an exclusive search-window boundary mismatch;
the corrected shared implementation passes the complete matrix. The reference
module is neither linked into production nor retained as a second converter.
This establishes these sampled numeric cases, not every possible PCM sequence,
decoder equivalence or listening quality. The source and scope audit is
`docs/siglus-koe-source-audit.json` in the repository root.
